rows.headline: Gartner predicts 70% abandon vendor agentic AI

rows.headline: Brandeis moves campus comms to Zoom platform

rows.headline: Netcall adds AI process capture to Liberty Spark
rows.sowhat: New capabilities turn business knowledge into searchable processes and auto-generated apps, aiming to reduce manual workflow configuration.

rows.headline: BearingPoint: 73% see AI value, 13% scale it
rows.sowhat: A 1,050-executive study confirms organisational discipline, not tech readiness, is the primary barrier to moving pilots into production.
